mapper.select: SELECT collection_id, policy_number, installment_no, due_date, planned_amount, collected_amount, unpaid_amount, late_fee, payment_method, processing_result, collected_at, transfer_type, transferred_at, created_at FROM contract_payment_collection WHERE collection_id = #{collectionId}

SELECT collection_id, policy_number, installment_no, due_date, planned_amount, collected_amount, unpaid_amount, late_fee, payment_method, processing_result, collected_at, transfer_type, transferred_at, created_at FROM contract_payment_collection WHERE policy_number = #{policyNumber} ORDER BY installment_no DESC, created_at DESC

WITH latest_collection AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (policy_number, installment_no) policy_number, installment_no FROM contract_payment_collection ORDER BY policy_number, installment_no, created_at DESC ), processed AS ( SELECT policy_number, MAX(installment_no) AS last_installment_no FROM latest_collection GROUP BY policy_number ), candidate AS ( SELECT c.policy_number, c.insured_name, c.premium_amount AS planned_amount, c.account_number, c.account_bank, COALESCE(p.last_installment_no, 0) + 1 AS installment_no, ( c.contract_start_date + ( (COALESCE(p.last_installment_no, 0)) * CASE c.payment_cycle WHEN 'MONTHLY' THEN 1 WHEN 'QUARTERLY' THEN 3 WHEN 'SEMI_ANNUALLY' THEN 6 WHEN 'ANNUALLY' THEN 12 ELSE 1 END ) * INTERVAL '1 month' )::DATE AS due_date, c.installment_count FROM contract c LEFT JOIN processed p ON p.policy_number = c.policy_number WHERE c.contract_status = 'ACTIVE' ) SELECT policy_number, insured_name, installment_no, due_date, planned_amount, account_number, account_bank FROM candidate WHERE installment_no <= installment_count AND due_date <= CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY due_date, policy_number

WITH latest_collection AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (policy_number, installment_no) policy_number, installment_no, unpaid_amount, processing_result FROM contract_payment_collection ORDER BY policy_number, installment_no, created_at DESC ) SELECT c.policy_number, c.insured_name, COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS unpaid_installment_count, SUM(lc.unpaid_amount) AS unpaid_amount FROM contract c JOIN latest_collection lc ON lc.policy_number = c.policy_number WHERE lc.processing_result = 'FAILED' GROUP BY c.policy_number, c.insured_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY unpaid_installment_count DESC, c.policy_number

WITH latest_collection AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (installment_no) installment_no, processing_result FROM contract_payment_collection WHERE policy_number = #{policyNumber} ORDER BY installment_no, created_at DESC ) SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER FROM latest_collection WHERE processing_result = 'FAILED'
